one_line_pitch: Finds flaky tests in your CI pipeline, quarantines them automatically, and shows which service and commit made them flaky.
problem_it_solves: In teams running many services, flaky tests fail builds at random, engineers re-run pipelines instead of shipping, and trust in CI drops. Nobody owns the flaky tests because nobody can see which ones they are.
ideal_customer_signals: CI defined in code (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, Jenkins, Buildkite, GitLab CI)
large or growing test suites (unit, integration and end-to-end frameworks present)
job posts mentioning CI reliability, build times, test infrastructure, developer productivity or platform engineering
high deploy frequency or active hiring of platform / developer experience engineers
